title: DOW-UAP-D092, Department of the Air Force Committee to Review Project Bluebook, 1966-1967
doc_notes: This document is a collection of memoranda and reports from the USAF Scientific Advisory Board regarding the review of Project Blue Book, containing summaries of historical UFO case investigations.

encounters.summary: A sighting of objects in Tremonton, Utah, involving motion picture film analysis by the USN Photo Interpretation Laboratory.
encounters.quote: The objects sighted were not birds, balloons or aircraft

encounters.summary: A sighting of objects in Great Falls, Montana, involving motion picture film.
encounters.quote: The objects in the Great Falls sighting are strongly suspected of being reflections of aircraft
